import.title: Import data
import.subtitle: Bring buildings, units, tenants, lease contracts and payments in from a spreadsheet. Every file is checked before anything is saved.
import.columnsHint: Capital letters and spacing in the headings do not matter, and extra columns are ignored.
import.formats: CSV and Excel (.xlsx) files are both accepted; from Excel, only the first sheet is read.
import.step2Hint: The whole file is read and every problem listed — nothing is saved yet.
import.readySummary: {valid} of {total} rows are ready. Rows with errors are skipped, not blocked.
import.skipNote: Rows listed above as errors will be skipped.
import.resource.properties.label: Buildings
import.resource.properties.hint: Import these first — units are linked to them by name.
import.resource.units.label: Units
import.resource.units.hint: Each row is matched to an existing building by its name.
import.resource.tenants.label: Tenants
import.resource.tenants.hint: Creates tenant records only — nobody is emailed until you invite them. The email may be left empty, and the name is one column.
import.resource.leases.label: Lease contracts
import.resource.leases.hint: Each row is created as the contract form creates it: its installments are billed and the unit is marked occupied. Add the tenants and units first — a tenant is found by national ID / iqama, email or phone, a unit by its building's name and its number. Give the contract total or the rent per installment; dates as YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY.
import.resource.payments.label: Payments
import.resource.payments.hint: Records money already received against a contract's installments, as the Record payment dialog does — receipts, balances and the books are updated. Name the contract by its number (or the tenant with the building and unit) and the installment by its invoice number or due date. Method: cash, pos, bank_transfer, owner_cash, owner_account or ejari. Tenants are not sent receipt messages.
